title: Cover the review-input mailbox-read failure and follow-up capture failure with fault-injection tests
outcome: Two review-input behaviours that need injected faults are covered: a mailbox read error during a reviewer submission refuses with [identity-mailbox-unavailable] and never verifies afresh, and a follow-up whose input capture fails names REVIEW_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE_BRIEF in its model-facing prompt and installs the unavailable reason at re-arm.
acceptance: A test injects a mailbox read failure into a read-only reviewer's submission and asserts [identity-mailbox-unavailable] with nothing published.
A test makes the follow-up's input capture fail and asserts the unavailable brief in the follow-up prompt, review_input_unavailable set at re-arm, and an [identity-unavailable] refusal.
